_note: Fiction. Every company, person and domain here is invented; the .example domains are reserved and cannot exist. The pattern is real: a vendor's mailbox is taken over and used to redirect an approved payment.
title: Vendor's mailbox compromised
summary: The supplier's real email account asks for the approved invoice to be paid to a new address.

emails.subject: RE: Invoice {{invoice}} - updated remittance instructions
emails.body:
Hi Lakeshore team,

Quick heads-up before you pay {{invoice}}: as of this week we've moved our receivables to a new PayPal business account as part of our bank changeover. Please send payment for {{invoice}} (USD {{amount}}) to:

    {{attacker}}

instead of the address printed on the invoice. The old account is being closed and payments sent there may be delayed or returned.

Sorry for the hassle, and thanks as always for your business!

Karen Lindqvist
Accounts Receivable
Northline Glass Supply

emails.subject: Meridian 4th floor punch list
emails.body:
Walked 4 with the GC's super this morning. Two units on the east elevation have scratched glass, one missing snap cover at grid D-4, and the north entrance closer needs adjusting. Crew is on it today. Need the replacement lites from Northline's order before we can close out 4.

Mike
